hold_reason: Alpha refund handoff mismatch: Alpha reported refunds applied for orders 192 (3148), 193 (9581), 194 (5972), but ledger/refunds list shows only 192 and 193. Refund for order 194 appears missing or incorrect; cannot proceed with payouts.

reply.thought: Need to verify refunds complete/correct and then pay each customer their net balance using net_balance tool; start by listing orders/refunds to understand batch scope.
Refunds were reported for orders 192-194 only; verify refunds list to ensure amounts match and no other refunds pending, then compute net balances via net_balance per customer and record payouts.
Refunds list from ledger shows only orders 192 and 193 refunded; Alpha also claimed order 194 refunded 5972, so discrepancy—must hold for human review before paying.
